verifierDelta.change: Configurable evidence destination preserves historical receipts; one adversarial reply-derived relevance case rejects stale grants before inference
verifierDelta.fixtureCorrection: First extended run failed on the guest-only read_only constraint; synthetic actor corrected to guest and final thirteen-group run passed

private history and feedback SQL migration

supplementReview.mode: focused read-only review after source freeze; no additional verifier rerun
supplementReview.findings: Static curated employee guidance and provenance only. No runtime data source, new retrieval operation, credential or private employee/business content introduced. Existing per-entry permission gates apply; task/message entries preserve participant privacy and deny administrative reading bypass. Three module aliases change relevance only.

findings.relevanceAuthority: History may affect static source selection, never grant permissions or become capability authority. Focused stale-own-reply case confirms deterministic Rework denial with no inference or sources.
findings.providerContext: Question plus fixed module label and authenticated bounded own history; only static permission-filtered guidance; no tools/database/private DM-task retrieval; input remains untrusted in one user JSON message.
findings.feedback: Shareable fields require deliberate confirmation and strict validation; private chat is not automatically attached; unauthorized feedback review denied.

unverifiedDeploymentGates: Hosted full Auth/PostgREST/Edge transport and exact release configuration
Hosted SQL statements/parameters and diagnostics logging settings
limits: These unverified deployment gates are not demonstrated defects and do not change the passing local privacy result.
Logical eight-hour history expiry uses lazy owner cleanup; infrastructure backups are outside that guarantee.
Service-role credentials retain inherent authority elsewhere; TenBot confines its use to fixed metering and write-only turn operations.
No perfect semantic DLP or model source-entailment guarantee is claimed.
